chapter: Blackbirds, Carmen Jones and the Ziegfeld Follies
title: Tightening the act: dancing over the laughs
summary: Cutting from 14 to 9 minutes meant talking and dancing on top of laughs and applause.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: And in terms of your comedy, you said you tighetened up the act. You didn't add anything to the act -- do you remember any additional bits or jokes that you did or things that you did specially for it?
I've got to tighten up, man. I told you how much time we spent at that hotel getting this act down to
9 minutes from 14. Tighten up on everything.

Yeah, because you know where the laughs are coming in. We talked on top of laughs, we danced on top of laughs and applause and everything when we got in the Follies when we cut it down, 'cause if they didn't get the gags, too bad. That's the way I went. So what can I do?
Ask me something -- that's the "Follies." We come out of the "Follies?"
